profiles.name: Halo 2 - Bumper Jumper
profiles.author: MeatMan Mods
profiles.description: Halo 3-inspired Bumper Jumper for Halo 2 default controls. LB jumps, RB melees, B reloads, A cycles grenades, D-pad Up activates flashlight, X sends original D-pad Up. Stock tuning; hardware validation pending.
